about_the_game:
The twelve major planets of the Alpha Galaxy jointly hosted this world-renowned shooting championship. After multiple rounds of selection, the twelve teams with the strongest combat power will represent their respective planets in the final interstellar competition to determine the winner!

And you, as a visitor from another galaxy, will have the opportunity to accept an invitation and teleport to a combat mech in the Alpha galaxy to personally participate in this great competition of strong players!

You will continuously upgrade your team during the competition, experience different genres of tactics, strengthen your mechs, protect friendly UFOs, and launch powerful special missiles to strike opponents.

One hundred teams with different styles are waiting for you to challenge! There will be even more dangerous teams joining in the future!

Although each participating team has a different combat style and number of fighter jets, for the sake of fairness, the limit of Star Spirit Ore used by all teams during upgrades is fixed, and their strength is generally equivalent.

Only teams with the most reasonable allocation of upgrade plans and advanced driving skills have a chance to win the final championship!
